pages.title: The Original Void
pages.text: Late, I understood what distortion is. Not energy. The $(thing)void$() that was here before the world, leaking through my tear.$(br2)Every machine I built carries a little of it. That is why they work. So I fed them more.

pages.title: Upgrades
pages.text: Each machine grew a pocket for the void, at the right of its window, one slot for each kind: Speed, Productivity, Efficiency, and Parallel for the nexuses.$(br2)One upgrade per slot. When a core is taken down, its upgrades come with it.

pages.title: Corruption
pages.text: Void forced into a machine shows. Rifts tear open in its blocks, the End glimmering through, in the colors of what I fed it. They close and open elsewhere. More void, more rifts.$(br2)Nothing has broken. Yet.
$(l)Speed I$(). Every task half again as fast, for a tenth more energy.$(br2)The matrix burns half again as fast, and each stone gives 13%% less.
$(l)Speed II$(). Twice as fast, for a fifth more energy.$(br2)The matrix burns twice as fast, and each stone gives 23%% less.
$(l)Speed III$(). Three times as fast, for 30%% more energy.$(br2)The matrix burns three times as fast, and each stone gives 33%% less.
$(l)Speed IV$(). Four times as fast, for 40%% more energy.$(br2)The matrix burns four times as fast, and each stone gives 43%% less.

pages.title: Productivity
pages.text: More from the same matter, though each machine shows it differently. My measurements are written under each rune. The nexuses grant it to every stage.$(br2)The matrix simply draws more DE from each stone.

pages.title: Efficiency
pages.text: Less energy for the same work.$(br2)Speed and Efficiency balance each other. With the fourth Speed and the third Efficiency, my machines ran four times faster for about half the energy.
$(l)Efficiency I$(). A fifth less energy for every task.$(br2)In the matrix, one stone in seven burns without being used up.
$(l)Efficiency II$(). Two fifths less energy.$(br2)In the matrix, nearly one stone in three burns without being used up.
$(l)Efficiency III$(). Three fifths less, down to 40%% of the cost.$(br2)In the matrix, almost half the stones burn without being used up.
$(l)Parallel$(), for the nexuses alone. Every stage keeps the pace of the fastest, so none waits on another. Speed still adds on top.
